# mab

The package `mab` is a collection of functions related to movement and
habitat selection analyses. It also includes a few patches for functions
from the adehabitat package family (notably
[adehabitatLT](https://cran.r-project.org/package=adehabitatLT) and
[adehabitatHR](https://cran.r-project.org/package=adehabitatHR)).

## Installation

Install `mab` from CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("mab")
```

To install the package from GitHub (which may be ahead of CRAN from time
to time), use the package
[`remotes`](https://cran.r-project.org/package=remotes) or better
[`pak`](https://cran.r-project.org/package=pak) to install `mab`:

``` r

remotes::install_github("basille/mab")
pak::pkg_install("basille/mab")
```

## Getting started

Check the function reference list.

# Package index

## Movement and Habitat Analyses

### ltraj management

Functions to handle ltraj from adehabitatLT

- [`as.ltraj()`](http://basille.github.io/mab/reference/as.ltraj.md) :
  Working with Trajectories in 2D Space: the Class ltraj

- [`ld()`](http://basille.github.io/mab/reference/ld.md)
  [`dl()`](http://basille.github.io/mab/reference/ld.md) : Quick
  Conversion of Objects of Class ltraj from and to Dataframes

- [`infolocs()`](http://basille.github.io/mab/reference/infolocs.md) :
  Infolocs of an Object of Class ltraj

- [`kerneloverlap()`](http://basille.github.io/mab/reference/kerneloverlap.md)
  [`summary(`*`<kerneloverlap>`*`)`](http://basille.github.io/mab/reference/kerneloverlap.md)
  : Spatial Interaction between Animals Monitored Using Radio-Tracking

- [`kernelUD()`](http://basille.github.io/mab/reference/kernelUD.md) :
  Estimation of Kernel Home-Range

- [`ltraj2spdf()`](http://basille.github.io/mab/reference/ltraj2spdf.md)
  [`ltraj2sldf()`](http://basille.github.io/mab/reference/ltraj2spdf.md)
  :

  Conversion of the class `ltraj` to the package `sp`
